# Detection evaluation

**Engine** det-2026.11.3. **Corpus:** synthetic, hand-written, not field data. Generated by `pnpm eval`.

> **Read `holdout_test` first.** `core`, `benign`, `benign_hard` and `adversarial` were written by the rules' own author and are regression checks, not measurements. `holdout_*` (40 malicious, 40 benign) was written by a separate process with no sight of the rules. `holdout_dev` was then used to improve them. `holdout_test` has never been read, only scored. Before that work, the whole holdout set scored 40% recall with 18% false positives, against 100% and 0% on the author's own corpus. Still synthetic, not field data: these numbers **must not** be used in marketing.

| Set | n | Precision | Recall | False-positive rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| core | 36 | 100.0% | 100.0% | n/a |
| benign | 10 | n/a | n/a | 0.0% |
| benign_hard | 12 | n/a | n/a | 0.0% |
| adversarial | 8 | 100.0% | 25.0% | n/a |
| holdout_dev | 40 | 94.7% | 90.0% | 5.0% |
| holdout_test | 40 | 90.9% | 50.0% | 5.0% |
| all except adversarial | 58 | 100.0% | 100.0% | 0.0% |

Expected calibration error (5 bins): **0.152**
